capabilities: Chat about the current day's entry
Compare a day with a named person or another date
Title, highlight and rate life areas for days
Write results into frontmatter, callouts and Summaries notes
extras: Chats are not saved; settings hold only API keys, models and suggestion lists. News lookups about living people can be turned off. Journal Scroll 0.4.0+ is needed for titles and highlights.
intentEvidence: An AI companion for Journal Scroll
problem: Journal Scroll entries have no built-in AI, so reflecting on a day, comparing it with someone or a past date, titling, rating life areas and summarizing months must be done by hand.
